title: Fixed Through Mouth and Rear Lever Wood Figure
description: One independently authored whole wooden lever-jaw figure in a fixed standing display pose. A broad finite plinth holds two full long shoes, separate legs and one shaped solid torso with two simple complete arms and blunt hands. A thick continuous head has a real front-to-back rectangular mouth tunnel. One entire bent lower-jaw and long rear lever member passes through that mouth around a separately supported transverse pin, leaving a visibly open gap beneath the upper lip. A low plain cap, nose, two eyes and simple cheek details finish the new stylized wooden character. Unlike a suspended marionette it has no overhead strings, jointed elbows or knees, or control cross; unlike an empty dental articulator it has a full standing figure and an integral rear-handled jaw member instead of opposed mounting discs. All visible coordinates newly authored; no old puppet, clamp or human mesh imported. Four opaque constant PBR materials, one whole toy prop zero scenes, metres native Z up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. Static nutcracker-inspired exterior only, no food or nut present: no lever motion, bite force, joint range, crushing, food-contact suitability, child suitability, pinch protection, manufacture, toy operation or safety claim. No historical costume attribution, rigging, animation or interaction.
